title: Su’aalaha inta badan la is weydiiyo

items.q: Sida loo ogaado jihada Qiblada si sax ah
steps: Taabo Qiblada ee shaashadda hoyga (ama ka hel Wax kale).
U oggolow barnaamijka inuu galo goobtaada marka laguu weydiiyo, si jihadaada hadda si toos ah loo dejiyo.
Qalabka si siman u qabo; haddii jiheeyuhu u baahan yahay hagaajin, u dhaqaaji qaab tirada 8 ah — badhanka (?) ee shaashadda Qiblada ayaa ku tusaya sida loo sameeyo.
Fallaadhu si toos ah ayay ugu jeesan doontaa Kacbada marka hagaajintu dhammaato.

items.q: Sida loo beddelo habka xisaabinta waqtiyada salaadda iyo madhabka
steps: Ka gal Wax kale → Dejinta → Habka xisaabinta.
Dooro hay’adda ku habboon gobolkaaga: Hay’adda Guud ee Masaarida, Umm Al-Qura, Ururka Caalamka Islaamka (Muslim World League), Jaamacadda Karachi, ama Bulshada Islaamka ee Waqooyiga Ameerika.
Si aad u hagaajiso waqtiga Casarka, taabo "Madhabka — saxidda salaadda Casarka" oo dooro "Shaafici / Xanbali / Maaliki" ama "Xanafi".
Sidoo kale salaad kasta waxaad gacanta ku hormarin kartaa ama dib u dhigi kartaa "Hagaaji waqtiyada salaadda (hore/dambe)" isla bogga Dejinta.

items.q: Shidista ogeysiisyada aadaanka iyo hubinta inay ka shaqeeyaan gadaasha
steps: Ka gal Wax kale → Dejinta → Ogeysiisyo, oo shid "Ogeysiisyada Salaadda" (marka hore waa in goobtaada la dejiyo).

Si aadaanku u shaqeeyo xitaa markaad barnaamijka xirto: Wax kale → Dejinta, taabo "Daar shaqada gadaasha (si loo hubiyo ogeysiisyada)" si uu kuugu furo bogga barnaamijka ee dejinta qalabkaaga, kadibna fur Batteriga oo dooro "Xaddidaad la’aan" ama dami hagaajinta batteriga ee barnaamijka.

Taleefannada qaarkood (sida Xiaomi, Huawei iyo Samsung) waxay qufulaad dheeraad ah saaraan barnaamijyada gadaasha — ka raadi 'Autostart' ama 'App Protection' dejinta qalabka oo u shid Rafiq Al-Muslim.

items.q: Ma dhegaysan karaa tilaawada Qur’aanka anigoo aan internet haysan?
steps: Fur Mushafka, taabo astaanta liiska (☰) ee sare, oo dooro "Codka".
Qaybta "Akhristayaasha", taabo astaanta soo dejinta ee ku ag taal akhriste si aad u soo dejiso tilaawadiisa oo dhan, ama fur akhristaha oo soo deji suuradaha aad rabto oo keliya.
Marka la soo dejiyo, waxaad dhegaysan kartaa wakhti kasta adigoon internet haysan; barnaamijku sidoo kale wuu kaydiyaa aayadaha aad hore u shiday.
Tilaawooyinka la soo dejiyay waxaad ka maamuli kartaa ama ka tirtiri kartaa Wax kale → Dejinta → Xogta la kaydiyay.

items.q: Sida loo isticmaalo Tasbiixa iyadoo la adeegsanayo aqoonsiga codka ee dikriga
steps: Shaashadda Tasbiixa, taabo astaanta makarafoonka.
Oggolow fasaxa makarafoonka marka ugu horreysa.
Dikriga si cad u dheh; barnaamijku wuu aqoonsanayaa oo tiriyaha ayuu si toos ah u kordhinayaa.
Aqoonsiga codku wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa Carabi oo keliya, si loo hubiyo aqoonsi sax ah oo adkaarta.

items.q: Ku darista dikri cusub ama ka tirtiridda mid liiska adkaarta
steps: Shaashadda Tasbiixa, taabo astaanta liiska (≡) ee sare si aad u furto liiska adkaarta.
Si aad wax ugu darto: taabo astaanta + ee sare, kadib geli qoraalka dikriga iyo tirada hadafka ah ee aad rabto.
Si aad u tirtirto: taabo astaanta wax-ka-beddelka (✎), kadib taabo badhanka tirtirka ee ku ag yaal dikriga aad rabto (adkaarta barnaamijka ku jira lama tirtiri karo).
Sidoo kale waxaad dib u habayn kartaa adkaarta adigoo si dheer u riixaya astaanta jiidista oo jiidaya.

items.q: Maxay codka aadaanka mararka qaarkood u daahaa iPhone-ka?
steps: iOS wuxuu xaddidaa shidista codka gadaasha si loo badbaadiyo tamarta, sidaas darteed digniinta aadaanku waxay ka daahi kartaa dhawr ilbiriqsi waqtiga dhabta ah.
Hubi in ogeysiisyada barnaamijka laga shiday iPhone Settings → Notifications → Rafiq Al-Muslim.
Sidoo kale hubi in habka 'Do Not Disturb' ama 'Focus' aanu shidnayn waqtiga salaadda.

Fur barnaamijka ugu yaraan hal mar dhawrkii maalmoodba: wuxuu aadaanka u jadwaleeyaa dhawr maalmood oo keliya oo hore (iPhone-ku wuxuu xaddidaa tirada digniinaha uu barnaamij jadwalayn karo), furiddiisuna waxay cusboonaysiisaa jadwalka.
Ka gal Wax kale → Dejinta → Luqadda.

Ka dooro 19 luqadood oo la taageero: Carabi, Ingiriis, Urduu, Faarisi, Turki, Indoniisiyaan, Malaay, Ruush, Hindi, Bangaali, Hawsa, Faransiis, Shiineys, Bashtuu, Bunjaabi (Gurmukhi iyo Shahmukhi), Usbek (Latin iyo Cyrillic) iyo Soomaali.
Luqadda cusub isla markiiba ayaa lagu dabaqaa barnaamijka oo dhan.

items.q: Sida loo shido habka mugdiga oo loo habeeyo muuqaalka
steps: Ka gal Wax kale → Dejinta → Muuqaalka iyo habka habeenka.
Ka dooro midabka aad jeceshahay qolka midabada ee la heli karo.
Dooro habka muuqaalka: Toos (raac nidaamka), Habka Iftiinka, ama Habka Mugdiga.

items.q: Sideen u maareeyaa meesha barnaamijku ka qaato qalabkayga?
steps: Ka gal Wax kale → Dejinta → Xogta la kaydiyay.
Waxaad heli doontaa wadarta meesha la isticmaalay, oo loo kala qaybiyay kutubta xadiiska, tilaawooyinka Qur’aanka iyo codka adkaarta.

Waxaad mid mid u nadiifin kartaa kutubta xadiiska ama tilaawooyinka la soo dejiyay, ama isticmaal "Nadiifi kaydka ku-meel-gaarka ah" si aad dhammaan — oo ay ku jiraan codka adkaarta — hal mar u nadiifiso.

items.q: Shidista shaqada gadaasha ee taleefannada Xiaomi (MIUI)
steps: Fur dejinta qalabka → Apps → Manage Apps → Rafiq Al-Muslim.
Shid 'Autostart'.
Qaybta Battery Saver, dooro 'No restrictions' halkii aad ka dooran lahayd 'Battery saver'.
Shaashadda hoyga, fur barnaamijyadii dhowaa (Recent Apps), si dheer u riix Rafiq Al-Muslim, oo shid 'Lock' si aanu nidaamku u xirin.

items.q: Shidista shaqada gadaasha ee taleefannada Huawei iyo Honor
steps: Fur dejinta qalabka → Battery → App Launch.
Raadi Rafiq Al-Muslim oo dami maaraynta tooska ah.
Gacanta ku shid: Auto-launch, Secondary launch iyo Run in background.
Sidoo kale hubi in barnaamijka lagu daray liiska Protected Apps haddii uu jiro.

items.q: Shidista shaqada gadaasha ee taleefannada Samsung
steps: Fur dejinta qalabka → Device Care → Battery → Background usage limits.
Hubi in Rafiq Al-Muslim aanu ku jirin 'Sleeping apps' ama 'Apps that are put to sleep automatically'.
Dejinta barnaamijka laftiisa, dooro Battery oo dooro 'Unrestricted'.

items.q: Maxaa iPhone-ku aanu si toos ah ugu wareegin habka aamusnaanta waqtiga salaadda?
steps: iOS uma oggola barnaamij dibadeed inuu beddelo habka codka ama si toos ah u shido 'Do Not Disturb' isagoo isticmaalaha ku matalaya — tani waa xaddidaad ay Apple dejisay oo khusaysa dhammaan barnaamijyada.
Taa beddelkeeda, waxaad samaysan kartaa 'Focus' gaar ah oo loogu talagalay waqtiyada salaadda iPhone Settings → Focus, oo gacanta ugu jadwalayn kartaa sida waqtiyada salaadda magaaladaada.

items.q: Wax ogeysiis ah kama helayo barnaamijka gabi ahaanba — maxaan sameeyaa?
steps: Marka hore, hubi in "Ogeysiisyada Salaadda" iyo/ama xusuusinta adkaarta laga shiday Wax kale → Dejinta → Ogeysiisyo.
Hubi in barnaamijka la siiyay fasaxa ogeysiisyada dejinta qalabka.
Android: hubi in barnaamijka laga reebay hagaajinta batteriga (eeg su’aalaha kor ku xusan ee qalab kasta u gaarka ah).
iPhone: hubi in 'Focus' ama 'Do Not Disturb' aanu shidnayn, iyo in ogeysiisyada laga shiday iPhone Settings → Notifications → Rafiq Al-Muslim.

items.q: Jiheeyaha shaashadda Qiblada wuxuu bixiyaa jiho aan sax ahayn
steps: Ka fogow ilo kasta oo birlab ah oo dhow (sameecado, galal birlab leh, qalab kale oo koronto ah).
Qalabka hawada ugu dhaqaaji qaab tirada 8 ah si aad dib ugu hagaajiso dareemaha jiheeyaha.
Hubi in goobta saxnaanta sare leh (GPS) laga shiday dejinta qalabka.
Dib u fur shaashadda Qiblada kadib hagaajinta si aad u hubiso in jihadu deggan tahay.

Taabo makarafoonka ku jira xariiqa raadinta ee shaashadda hoyga. Raadinta codku waxay dhegaysataa luqadda hadda barnaamijka, raadinta laftigeeduna waxay fahmaysaa dhammaan 19-ka luqadood ee barnaamijka.

Aqoonsigu wuxuu isticmaalaa aqoonsiga hadalka ee taleefankaaga ee luqaddaas: Android-ka, barnaamijka Google (adeegyada hadalka) waa inuu taageeraa — waxaa laga yaabaa inaad u baahato inaad soo dejiso xirmada luqadda; iPhone-ka, Dictation waa in laga shido Settings → General → Keyboard, iyadoo lagu daray kiiboodhka luqaddaas.
Haddii taleefankaagu aanu lahayn aqoonsi hadal oo luqadda barnaamijka ah, raadinta codku waxay ku dhegaysataa Carabi.
Mar walba waxaad gacanta ku qori kartaa raadintaada, luqad kasta oo barnaamijka ka mid ah, taasoo ah beddel la isku halleyn karo.

items.q: Halkee ka yimaadaan qiimaha dahabka iyo lacagta (fiddada) ee xisaabiyaha Sakada?
steps: Barnaamijku wuxuu qiimaha dahabka, fiddada iyo lacagaha ka soo qaataa ilo dadweyne markaad furto xisaabiyaha, wuxuuna dib u isticmaalaa qiimihii ugu dambeeyay haddii ay ka yar yihiin 6 saacadood.
Haddii aanu jirin internet, barnaamijku wuxuu isticmaalaa qiimihii ugu dambeeyay ee lagu kaydiyay qalabkaaga.
Mar walba waxaad geli kartaa qiime gacanta ah haddii aad rabto inaad isticmaasho qiime kale oo waddankaaga laga isticmaalo.
